title: Frame
summary: A sandboxed iframe (an inline srcdoc document or a same-site src) with named width presets and a light/dark theme hand-off.

props.name: title
props.description: The framed document's accessible name; warns once when empty.

props.name: html
props.description: An inline document, written as the frame's srcdoc. Ignored when src is set.

props.name: src
props.description: A same-site path or an http(s) address to load; takes priority over html.

props.name: sandbox
props.description: Space-separated sandbox tokens. allow-same-origin is dropped when allow-scripts is also present, unless allowSameOrigin opts in.

props.name: allowSameOrigin
props.description: Adds allow-same-origin to sandbox even alongside allow-scripts; only for a trusted, cooperating document.

props.name: preset
props.description: A named width cap from tokens/breakpoints.json (phone, tablet, desktop -> the wide breakpoint) or full (no cap).

props.name: height
props.description: auto keeps a fallback height until a cooperating document posts pk-frame-resize; any other value is a CSS length.

props.name: theme
props.description: Handed to a cooperating document as ?pk-theme= on a same-origin src and as a postMessage; inherit sends nothing.

events.name: pk-frame-resize
events.description: A cooperating document reported its height (height="auto" only).

cssProperties.name: --pk-frame-background
cssProperties.description: Frame background before the document paints.

methods.name: resolveSandbox(sandbox, allowSameOrigin)
methods.description: The sandbox token string actually applied.

methods.name: withThemeParam(url, theme, base)
methods.description: url with ?pk-theme= appended when it is same-origin with base.

a11y: title is the framed document's accessible name (like an ordinary iframe title, required for assistive tech); pk-frame warns once when it is empty. The framed document is a separate document for a screen reader - its own headings and landmarks are not part of this page's outline. Reduced motion: pk-frame never animates the resize itself, so it respects whatever the OS setting already does to the surrounding page.

examples.title: Inline document, tablet width
examples.html: <pk-frame title="Preview" preset="tablet" html='<!doctype html><body>Hello from the frame</body>'></pk-frame>

examples.title: Full width
examples.html: <pk-frame title="Wide preview" preset="full" html='<!doctype html><body>A full-width sandboxed document</body>'></pk-frame>
